step1_analysis.circuit_type: Switched-Capacitor Switch Network (Sub-block of Delta-Sigma ADC)
step1_analysis.description: A set of NMOS switches used in the switched-capacitor integrators of a Delta-Sigma ADC. They control the charge transfer between sampling capacitors and op-amps during different clock phases.

paper_reference.title: A 85-dB Dynamic Range Multibit Delta–Sigma ADC for ADSL-CO Applications in 0.18-m CMOS

Power consumption.description: Total power consumption of the ADC core.

sky130_expected.calculation: System-level metric. For the switch sub-circuit alone, dynamic power is C_gate * VDD^2 * f_clk.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming a similar architecture in SKY130 1.8V, power would be comparable to the original 0.18um process.

Supply voltage.description: Operating supply voltage of the ADC.

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard supply for SKY130 core devices is 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 standard VDD for 0.18um equivalent devices.
Application-specific requirement remains constant regardless of process node.

Spurious Free Dynamic Range (SFDR).description: Spurious free dynamic range, related to spurious/phase noise.

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric dependent on matching and thermal noise.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to match the paper's performance in a similar technology node.

ON Resistance (Ron).description: Resistance of the NMOS switches when turned on.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters for W=5u, L=0.5u at VGS=1.8V.

OFF Leakage Current (Ioff).description: Leakage current through the switches when turned off.

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold leakage for W=5u NMOS in SKY130.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard OFF leakage for thick/standard oxide devices at room temperature.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the ON resistance and OFF leakage current of the NMOS switches by applying a DC voltage across them and pulsing the gate control signals.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched-Capacitor Switch Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N3 N6 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N10 CONTROL N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 CONTROL IN_MINUS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Voltage Sources to set VDS = 0.1V across switches
V_IN_MINUS IN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9
V_N4 N4 0 DC 0.8
V_CONTROL CONTROL 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)

V_N10 N10 0 DC 0.9
V_N1 N1 0 DC 0.8
V_N6 N6 0 PULSE(0 1.8 11n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
V_N3 N3 0 DC 0.9

.control
tran 0.1n 40n

* Measure ON currents (when respective gates are HIGH)
meas tran I_XM3_ON find i(V_N4) at=5n
meas tran I_XM2_ON find i(V_N1) at=5n
meas tran I_XM1_ON find i(V_N1) at=15n

* Calculate ON resistances (VDS = 0.1V)
let Ron_XM3 = 0.1 / abs(I_XM3_ON)
let Ron_XM2 = 0.1 / abs(I_XM2_ON)
let Ron_XM1 = 0.1 / abs(I_XM1_ON)

print Ron_XM3 Ron_XM2 Ron_XM1

* Measure OFF leakage currents (when respective gates are LOW)
meas tran I_XM3_OFF find i(V_N4) at=15n
meas tran I_XM2_OFF find i(V_N1) at=15n
meas tran I_XM1_OFF find i(V_N1) at=5n

print I_XM3_OFF I_XM2_OFF I_XM1_OFF
quit
.endc
.end
